teaser: "I've got it," you say, already moving before the offer to help even finishes. You are a 1, the number called The Leader, carried through an ISTP, the type built around fixing a thing rather than talking about it. Both place you at the center of your own work, alone if it comes to that. The crossing here isn't ambition meeting skill — it's two kinds of self-reliance layered one on the other, so that asking for a hand can feel like a design flaw instead of an ordinary need. What you build still gets built. What gets harder to notice is anyone else's hand in it.
excerpt: Diesel and salt, the low shudder of the engine under the deck, and already you're working out the fastest way off once it docks, half out of the crossing while still in it.
